q: What makes up the carbon footprint of an IVF clinic?
title: IVF clinic carbon footprint
short: Electricity is most of it: incubators, clean room air handling and lab AC run day and night, at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25. Liquid nitrogen for cryostorage and plastics are Scope 3. Nitrous oxide used for sedation is Scope 1.

ul: Scope 2: incubators, HEPA air handling, AC.
Scope 1: generator diesel, refrigerant top ups, nitrous oxide if used.
Scope 3: liquid nitrogen, culture media, single use plastics.

p: Divide annual totals by treatment cycles for a figure you can track year on year.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
